column1: Tab 9 — Worked Example (founder's scenario, v2 model)

Scenario: user opens NUCCESS with a presentation to prepare, feels overwhelmed and unable to start, deadline in ~5 hours. Use as a unit test — 'Engine output' is the expected correct behaviour under the v2 model.

column3: Name: “Flow Entering.” Plain language: “Getting going, though mood’s still catching up — ease in.” Baseline capacity band: Conditional. (Tab 1)

column2: Anxious, Restless (2 of max 3); Intensity: Anxious=7, Restless=8 → peak = 8 (High band)
column3: Anxious+High → Regulate triggered as forced-first (Tab 2); Restless → add movement-based Regulate option to alternatives.
Body/energy family → reduce physical demand, seated Regulate first.
Regulate tools filtered to discreet/seated variants (Tab 3b); Move/visible tools excluded.
Reinforces discreet/low-stimulation choice; headphone-routed only; avoid screen/video Regulate tools (Tab 3a).

column2: Demand: “Prepare a presentation at a meeting.” Timeline: within 5 hours → T1 (Hours).
column3: Demand type → Collaboration (presenting to others) + Challenge (multi-stage) (Tab 6). Timeline T1 → Urgency = high weight, cap breakdown to 3-5 steps (Tab 4).

column2: Feel calm / reduce overwhelm; get ideas / break into tiny steps
column3: Two needs → sequence: Regulate first (forced by step 3), Execute (task breakdown) queued to auto-surface after.

Final band: Constrained (State baseline Conditional, lowered one step by the Experience modifier for High-intensity anxiety, Tab 10 rule EX-1). Context modifier CX-1 does not apply because Work is not a public or unfamiliar setting. Traffic light: Constrained indicator.
Tags: Urgency (high weight, T1) + Collaboration + Challenge. (Tabs 5-6)

PRIMARY: “Let's reduce the load first” → [Try a short reset] opens Regulate pre-filtered to discreet, seated, headphone-based tools. Rationale shown: “Because your anxious/restless intensity is high right now, Nuccess suggests a quick reset before your presentation.” Alternatives: “I'll try the task anyway” / “Get support now.” Matches Recommendation Matrix Pattern #5 (Tab 7).

column2: User completes a 2-minute Breathe session; re-check shows improved state
column3: Auto-surface queued Execute: “Ready to break your presentation into steps?” → Task Detail/Break Down capped at 3-5 micro-steps (Timeline T1, Tab 4). AI Body Double offered by default (no lead time to invite a person under T1).

column2: User completes steps; gives feedback “did this help?”
column3: Logged against: Cell E3M2 + Anxious/Restless High + Work/Sound-Noise-Lights-Crowd context + T1 Timeline + Regulate-then-Execute sequence + rule_version/model_version (per v2 FR-15). Feeds personalisation (FR-12) without overriding future check-ins.
